record_title: Two-prime rigidity for prime-power pseudoperfect and prime-power Giuga numbers
scientific_context: At exactly two distinct prime factors, the sufficient Fermat/Mersenne families for Machacek's prime-power Egyptian-fraction classes are exhaustive: the pseudoperfect side is 2^a(2^a+1)^b and the Giuga side is 2^a(2^a-1), subject to primality of the odd factor.
limitations: The classification is restricted to integers with exactly two distinct prime factors. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; no exact prior converse was located, but a short equivalent argument could exist under different terminology in poorly indexed problem or sequence literature.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-rational verification of the two classifications on all prime pairs p<q<=200 and exponents 1<=a,b<=6.
Deterministic verification output for 37,260 parameter tuples, with 18 pseudoperfect hits, 3 Giuga hits, and zero mismatches.
